    • shiftDrawingAnchors

      public void shiftDrawingAnchors(int startRow, int endRow, int n)
      Shift the anchors of the shapes (pictures, charts, ...) in the sheet's drawing along with the rows they are anchored to. A shape is moved when its top-left anchor row is within [startRow, endRow]; the whole shape is moved so it keeps its size. Comments are not moved by this method.
      Parameters:
      startRow - the row to start shifting
      endRow - the row to end shifting
      n - the number of rows to shift
      Since:
      6.0.0
